notes.title: Warmly Celebrate Labor Day
notes.content: [p]Today is Labor Day. On May 1, 1886, the working class launched massive strikes and demonstrations demanding an eight-hour workday, which escalated into violent clashes resulting in hundreds of casualties. To commemorate this historic moment in the advancement of human civilization and democracy, the Paris Congress led by Engels designated May 1 as International Workers' Day. and in the United States and Canada, the first Monday in September is observed as Labor Day.[/p][p]To further promote the historical significance of advancing humanity's democratization process, we announce that starting today, Pyramid Game will permanently remove all Pyramids from the Pyramid Store. All Pyramids can now only be obtained through Pyramid Game and community trading. This allows all Pyramid citizens to truly understand the meaning of labor and inspires the fundamental awakening that we are all born human.[/p]

notes.title: Pyramid Game, Back to the People!
notes.content: [p]For the purpose of inspiring the citizens of Pyramid World to work and to raise the social insurance and minimum salary standards across the board, Pyramid World Decentralized Autonomous Organization officially announced a major policy today, where all Pyramid Citizens will receive $1 social insurance for every 10 seconds, which is $6 for 1 minute, $360 for 1 hour, and $8,640 for 1 day. These social insurance payments will be deposited directly into your bank account and can be invested or traded instantly. You can use it to gamble for more capital, or you can exchange it for any pyramid you want on the bank's “Pay & transfer” page. Don't forget that you can always convert your pyramids into money by clicking on the convert icon button on the page. Never forget that you can freely trade pyramids in the community anytime, anywhere. notes.title: Pyramid Game Social Welfare Officially Ended
notes.content:
Fellow citizens of Pyramid Game, the Pyramid World Decentralized Autonomous Organization is here to announce with great pride that the 7 pyramids currency in the Pyramid Game will never drop within the game. This is our great feat, we aim to reduce the wealth gap between the citizens of Pyramid Game World, now please feel free to let the pyramids circulate in the New World!

notes.title: Pyramid Store Now Available!
notes.content:
Today, Pyramid Game officially launched the Pyramid Store. Players can explore the in-game bank page to discover how to exchange pyramids and assets. As with our original intent, we don't see this as microtransactions, but rather as providing a way to make it possible for the game to have contact with reality. Similarly, the pricing in the pyramid store is in no way intended to be purchased by players, but rather serves as a price reference, and the price of anything should be determined by the market with no right to interfere. Our policy of dropping a random pyramid every hour is more of a benefit to all pyramid citizens from the Pyramid DAO. In the future, whatever decision we make must only result in fewer and fewer pyramids being issued. More importantly, it is now best that any player does not attempt to modify or delete the game data or cheat in any way, as we have added a pyramid monitoring system that will instantly wipe out the player's assets without alerting them to any anomalies in the data. Of course, the punishment is only that, we will not prohibit players from re-entering the Pyramid New World, because we the Pyramid Citizen, we are born equal, with freedom and democracy, and we hold these truths to be self-evident and inalienable.
